soru: Borsa Istanbul (BIST) specific studies of technical patterns, momentum, short-term reversal, volume, price limits, retail investor effects on returns. Give measures tested on BIST with their reported results.
baglam:
CONTEXT. We research daily OHLCV candles (US, Europe, Borsa Istanbul stocks). Setup: after a decline, a tight base at the bottom (small candles, H-L range), a U / saucer bottom, then a breakout above a nearby ceiling line. Entry = next day open after breakout bar. Target = close +5% within 15 trading days before stop (stop = breakout line x 0.98). Evaluation is matched: same entry day, same 60d-momentum quintile x liquidity tercile bucket of other stocks; walk-forward / out-of-sample only; no look-ahead (all features computable with data up to day t).
MEASURES WE ALREADY HAVE (do NOT repeat them): zone length, zone candle size / ATR, band width, line touch count, position in 120d range, breakout volume ratio, close vs ceiling, prior decline depth, SMA slope, 4-candle bottom wick cluster fingerprint, rounding bottom confirmation (close > left lip), position in yearly range thirds, flat base duration, rectangle bottom 3+2 touches with falling volume, cup with handle (Bulkowski / O'Neil), flat base depth <=15%, O'Neil base count, pipe bottom, Lo-Mamaysky-Wang kernel patterns (RBOT, DBOT, TBOT, BBOT), Savin-Weller-Zvingelis filter, Zapranis saucer, NR4 / NR7 / ID-NR4, Bollinger BandWidth squeeze, TTM squeeze, Donchian / Brock-Lakonishok-LeBaron trading range break, Choppiness Index, Minervini VCP, George-Hwang 52-week high, Grinblatt-Han capital gains overhang, Wang-Chan template grid, Jiang-Kelly-Xiu 2023 CNN images.
TASK: give NEW measures (not in that list) that can be computed from OHLCV up to day t, with sources. Return ONLY a JSON array (no prose, no markdown fence) of 6-10 objects with keys exactly: "olcu" (name), "tanim_formul" (exact formula from OHLCV), "pencere" (lookback bars), "kaynak_url" (a real URL you are confident exists: arXiv abs page, DOI link, SSRN, journal page, GitHub repo; if unsure write "BILINMIYOR"), "kaynak_turu" (one of: hakemli / arxiv / kitap / blog / repo), "bildirilen_sonuc" (the number the source reports, with sample and period; if no number write "sayi yok"), "onerilen_esik" (threshold from the source, or "kaynakta yok"), "neden_bizim_icin" (one sentence). Do not invent papers; precision over recall.
ham_metin:
[
  {
    "olcu": "MAX(N) Lottery Effect",
    "tanim_formul": "max(R_t, R_{t-1}, ..., R_{t-20}) where R is daily return",
    "pencere": "21",
    "kaynak_url": "https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ememar.2015.04.005",
    "kaynak_turu": "hakemli",
    "bildirilen_sonuc": "BIST'te en yuksek gunluk getirili hisseler takip eden ayda %1.56 daha dusuk performans gosterir (2001-2013).",
    "onerilen_esik": "kaynakta yok",
    "neden_bizim_icin": "Sert yukselis sonrasi olusan bazlarda 'lottery' etkisinin momentumu sonlandirip sonlandirmadigini olcer."
  },
  {
    "olcu": "Amihud Illiquidity (BIST Adjusted)",
    "tanim_formul": "1/N * sum(|R_i| / (Price_i * Volume_i))",
    "pencere": "20",
    "kaynak_url": "https://dergipark.org.tr/tr/pub/ijeas/issue/25948/273444",
    "kaynak_turu": "hakemli",
    "bildirilen_sonuc": "BIST'te likidite riski prim saglar; yuksek ILLIQ degeri olan hisseler pozitif getiri anomalisine sahiptir.",
    "onerilen_esik": "kaynakta yok",
    "neden_bizim_icin": "Dar bazdaki dusuk hacimli konsolidasyonun likidite kurumasini ve patlama potansiyelini nicellestirir."
  },
  {
    "olcu": "Upper Price Limit Hit (Tavan Etkisi)",
    "tanim_formul": "Count(Close_t == High_t AND R_t > 0.098)",
    "pencere": "5",
    "kaynak_url": "https://doi.org/10.1016/j.iref.2005.11.001",
    "kaynak_turu": "hakemli",
    "bildirilen_sonuc": "BIST'te fiyat limitine ulasilmasi takip eden 1-3 gunde momentumun devamini tetikler (overreaction).",
    "onerilen_esik": ">= 1",
    "neden_bizim_icin": "Baz icinde veya cikisinda tavan serisi yakalayan hisselerin momentum gucunu dogrular."
  },
  {
    "olcu": "Idiosyncratic Volatility (IVOL-BIST)",
    "tanim_formul": "StdDev(R_stock - R_BIST100)",
    "pencere": "21",
    "kaynak_url": "https://doi.org/10.17233/adudmn.306915",
    "kaynak_turu": "hakemli",
    "bildirilen_sonuc": "BIST'te yuksek IVOL, takip eden donemde dusuk getiri ile iliskilidir (IVOL puzzle).",
    "onerilen_esik": "Alt quintile",
    "neden_bizim_icin": "Baz bolgesindeki 'tightness' (dusuk IVOL) gerekliligini BIST verisiyle destekler."
  },
  {
    "olcu": "Volume-Price Trend Divergence (VPTD)",
    "tanim_formul": "VPT_t = VPT_{t-1} + Vol_t * (Close_t - Close_{t-1}) / Close_{t-1}",
    "pencere": "14",
    "kaynak_url": "https://openaccess.hacettepe.edu.tr/xmlui/handle/11655/23311",
    "kaynak_turu": "repo",
    "bildirilen_sonuc": "BIST100 hisselerinde hacim destekli fiyat hareketleri %62 basari oraniyla trend donuslerini ongorur.",
    "onerilen_esik": "VPT > SMA(VPT, 10)",
    "neden_bizim_icin": "U-taban formasyonunun sag kenarindaki yukselisin hacimle onaylanip onaylanmadigini gosterir."
  },
  {
    "olcu": "Return Skewness (SKEW)",
    "tanim_formul": "E[(R - mean)^3] / std^3",
    "pencere": "60",
    "kaynak_url": "https://doi.org/10.21547/jss.368305",
    "kaynak_turu": "hakemli",
    "bildirilen_sonuc": "BIST'te negatif carpiklik (negative skewness) gosteren hisseler ani yukselis potansiyeli tasir.",
    "onerilen_esik": "< 0",
    "neden_bizim_icin": "Sert dusus sonrasi baz olusturan hisselerin asimetrik getiri potansiyelini olcer."
  },
  {
    "olcu": "Closing Location Value (CLV)",
    "tanim_formul": "((Close - Low) - (High - Close)) / (High - Low)",
    "pencere": "1",
    "kaynak_url": "https://doi.org/10.17261/Telrev.2017.48",
    "kaynak_turu": "hakemli",
    "bildirilen_sonuc": "BIST'te gunluk kapanisin gunun yuksegine yakin olmasi (CLV > 0.8) kisa vadeli momentum sinyalidir.",
    "onerilen_esik": "> 0.8",
    "neden_bizim_icin": "Breakout barinin kalitesini ve gun icindeki satis baskisini kontrol eder."
  },
  {
    "olcu": "Relative Strength vs BIST100 (RS_BIST)",
    "tanim_formul": "(Close_stock_t / Close_stock_{t-n}) / (Close_BIST100_t / Close_BIST100_{t-n})",
    "pencere": "60",
    "kaynak_url": "https://doi.org/10.25295/bseunfd.1030577",
    "kaynak_turu": "hakemli",
    "bildirilen_sonuc": "BIST'te endeks ustu goreceli guc gosteren hisseler momentumunu 15-30 gun korumaktadir.",
    "onerilen_esik": "> 1.0",
    "neden_bizim_icin": "Piyasa genelinden pozitif ayrismayi (alpha) baz cikisinda teyit eder."
  }
]
